title: Commit-search asymmetry does not resolve M-004, M-005, or M-006

observed: The canonical queue keeps M-004, M-005, and M-006 unresolved under M-RECONCILE-002 and requires immutable provenance or exhaustive coverage before adjudication.
Repository code search for M-004 returned no result while repository metadata reported code search as unindexed.

Commit search for M-004 and M-006 located commit 83205275e023fccf602127ca4ff1cf3075bd1c26, whose diff is a later continuity reconciliation record that mentions all three identifiers but does not contain their originating artifacts.
Commit search for M-005 returned no result in this connector query despite the same later reconciliation commit visibly containing M-005 in its diff.
inferred: Connector commit-search matching is not a complete content traversal and may match commit messages, selected diffs, or indexed fragments inconsistently.
The located 2026-07-13 reconciliation commit establishes only a latest-known reference point for the identifiers, not their origin, authorship, or prior existence.
Search-result asymmetry across identifiers that co-occur in one immutable diff is direct evidence that zero-result commit search cannot be treated as absence proof.
proposed: Classify connector commit search as lead_generation_only for M-004, M-005, and M-006 unless its coverage is independently proven exhaustive.
Use the immutable reconciliation commit only as a temporal reference node and provenance lead, never as the source object resolving the three identifiers.
Require retained refs enumeration plus tree or blob traversal across every accessible branch before classifying any identifier as unlocated after exhaustive coverage.
superseded: Treating a commit-search hit as proof that the hit commit originated the referenced artifact.
Treating a zero-result commit search as evidence that an identifier is absent from repository history.
unresolved: The originating immutable objects for M-004, M-005, and M-006 remain unlocated.
The full branch, ref, tree, blob, and historical commit inventory remains unenumerated.
The decision log, language lexicon, project document, or chat-history source that assigned the identifiers remains unlocated.

contradiction_resolution.apparent_contradiction: M-005 is visibly present in the diff of a located reconciliation commit, yet an exact M-005 commit search returned zero results.
contradiction_resolution.resolution: The connector search is classified as non-exhaustive and index-dependent. The immutable commit diff is authoritative for what that commit contains; the zero-result search is only a coverage observation and cannot negate the diff.

privacy_boundary.publication_rule: Retain only repository provenance mechanics and claim classifications; do not reproduce private source material.

falsification_route: Produce retained exhaustive refs and object traversal showing complete coverage, or locate an immutable pre-existing source object whose namespace, owner, semantic role, temporal precedence, and locator resolve one of M-004, M-005, or M-006.
next_action: Build and retain an authenticated all-refs inventory, then traverse reachable trees and blobs for exact identifiers and source-assignment context.
